name: text-to-sql execution accuracy
metric: A question counts only when the agent's rows match the reference query's rows exactly, as an unordered multiset of normalised values. The reference SQL is hand-written and runs through the same read-only path, so the score is of the agent, not of the data.

questions.question: How many brands are active and not deleted?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "Brand" WHERE "status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "isDeleted" = false LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many products are published?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "status" = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average price of published products, rounded to 2 decimal places?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT round(avg("price")::numeric, 2) AS avg_price FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "status" = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 5 product categories have the most products? Return the category and the count, highest first, breaking ties alphabetically by category.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "category", count(*) AS n FROM "BrandProduct" GROUP BY "category" ORDER BY n DESC, "category" ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is the title and price of the most expensive published product? If several share the highest price, take the alphabetically first title.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "title", "price" FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "status" = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY "price" DESC, "title" ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many products are drape ready?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "isDrapeReady" = true LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many distinct product categories are there?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT "category") AS n FROM "BrandProduct" LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total stock across all published products?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT sum("stock") AS total_stock FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "status" = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many products are featured and have stock left?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "featured" = true AND "stock" > 0 LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many products were created in the last 30 days?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "createdAt" >= now() - interval '30 days' LIMIT 1

questions.question: List the 5 cheapest published products with their title and price, cheapest first, breaking ties alphabetically by title.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "title", "price" FROM "BrandProduct" WHERE "status" = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY "price" ASC, "title" ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many brands are verified?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "Brand" WHERE "isVerified" = true LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 5 brands have the most products? Return the brand name and the product count, highest first, breaking ties alphabetically by brand name.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT b."name", count(p."id") AS n FROM "Brand" b JOIN "BrandProduct" p ON p."brandId" = b."id" GROUP BY b."name" ORDER BY n DESC, b."name" ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many brand follows are there in total?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandFollow" LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the top 3 products by number of drapes? Return title and drapesCount, highest first, breaking ties alphabetically by title.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "title", "drapesCount" FROM "BrandProduct" ORDER BY "drapesCount" DESC, "title" ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the total number of clicks across products, grouped by category, for the top 5 categories? Break ties alphabetically by category.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "category", sum("clicksCount") AS clicks FROM "BrandProduct" GROUP BY "category" ORDER BY clicks DESC, "category" ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many brand events are there of each type?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "type"::text AS type, count(*) AS n FROM "BrandEvent" GROUP BY "type" ORDER BY n DESC, type ASC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many brand events happened in the last 7 days?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandEvent" WHERE "createdAt" >= now() - interval '7 days' LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many AI videos are there in each status?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "status", count(*) AS n FROM "BrandVideo" GROUP BY "status" ORDER BY n DESC, "status" ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: What is the average duration in seconds of videos that are ready?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT avg("durationSec") AS avg_duration FROM "BrandVideo" WHERE "status" = 'READY' LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many videos failed and were refunded?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandVideo" WHERE "status" = 'FAILED' AND "refunded" = true LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many promo reels are there in each status?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "status", count(*) AS n FROM "BrandReel" GROUP BY "status" ORDER BY n DESC, "status" ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: How many shots are there in total across all reels?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "BrandReelShot" LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total number of credits charged for reels, counting refunded ones too?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT sum("credits") AS total_credits FROM "BrandReel" LIMIT 1

questions.question: What percentage of AI requests succeeded? Round to 2 decimal places.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE "success") / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS success_pct FROM "AiRequestLog" LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total estimated cost in USD of all AI requests?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT sum("costUsd") AS total_cost FROM "AiRequestLog" LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 3 models were used for the most AI requests? Return the model and the count, highest first, breaking ties alphabetically by model.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "model", count(*) AS n FROM "AiRequestLog" GROUP BY "model" ORDER BY n DESC, "model" ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the average latency in milliseconds per provider for AI requests?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "provider", avg("latencyMs") AS avg_latency FROM "AiRequestLog" WHERE "latencyMs" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "provider" ORDER BY "provider" ASC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What is the average overall try-on eval score per engine?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "engine", avg("overallScore") AS avg_score FROM "TryOnEval" GROUP BY "engine" ORDER BY "engine" ASC LIMIT 20

questions.question: List the active discover categories by sort order, returning name and sortOrder.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT "name", "sortOrder" FROM "DiscoverCategory" WHERE "isActive" = true ORDER BY "sortOrder" ASC, "name" ASC LIMIT 50
